messages.subject: Species richness and distance sampling
parts:
Hello everyone and nice to meet you all,

I would be very interested to use distance sampling to model species richness, instead of abundance, but I have not found any research article or internet post mentioning this kind of analysis had already been done.

Therefore, I would like to ask you if you have already read about using distance sampling to model species richness, and/or if you think that could be a correct analysis to do?

Many thanks in advance !

Delphine

messages.author: f2122b34f1aa6e95
messages.subject: Re: [distance-sampling] Species richness and distance sampling
parts:
Delphine

Distance sampling is a method of estimating species abundance or density, so it is not used to directly measure species richness.  But there have been a few papers that try to incorporate elements of distance sampling, particularly issues surrounding rare species.  Here is a smattering of literature:

Buckland, S. T., Baillie, S., Dick, J., Elston, D., Magurran, A., Scott, M., Smith, R., Somerfield, P., Studeny, A. C., & Watt, A. (2012). How should regional biodiversity be monitored? Environmental and Ecological Statistics, 19(4), 601-626. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10651-012-0202-7

Buckland, S. T., Studeny, A. C., Magurran, A., & Newson, S. (2010). Biodiversity monitoring: the relevance of detectability. In A. Magurran, & B. McGill (Eds.), Biological Diversity: Frontiers in Measurement and Assessment (pp. 25-36). Oxford University Press.

Buckland, S. T. (2009). Quantifying biodiversity. Significance, 6(3), 105-107. https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1740-9713.2009.00371.x

Roberts TE, Bridge TC, Caley MJ, Baird AH (2016) The Point Count Transect Method for Estimates of Biodiversity on Coral Reefs: Improving the Sampling of Rare Species. PLoS ONE 11(3): e0152335. https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0152335

Yamaura, Y., and Royle, J. A.. 2017. Community distance sampling models allowing for imperfect detection and temporary emigration. Ecosphere 8( 12):e02028. 10.1002/ecs2.2028
